verses.sloka: स तस्य तु महानादं श्रुत्वा वैवस्वतः प्रभुः ।शत्रुं विजयिनं मेने स्वबलस्य च सङ्क्षयम् ।। ७.२२.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tasya tu mahānādaṁ śrutvā vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ ।śatruṁ vijayinaṁ mene svabalasya ca saṅkṣayam ।। 7.22.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that great roar, Lord Yama considered the enemy victorious and his own army destroyed.
translations.hindi: § उत्तरकाण्ड का बीसवा सग पूरा हुआ । ७ टि ७ ॥ पन 88 ~ एवं संचिन्त्य विप्रेन्द्रो जगाम लघुविक्रमः । आख्यातु तद्यथाइतत यस्य सदनं प्रति

verses.sloka: स हि योधान्हतान्मत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ।अब्रवीत्त्वरितं सूतं रथो ऽयमुपनीयताम् ।। ७.२२.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa hi yodhānhatānmatvā krodhasaṁraktalocanaḥ ।abravīttvaritaṁ sūtaṁ ratho 'yamupanīyatām ।। 7.22.2 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, he (Yama), considering his warriors killed and his eyes reddened with anger, quickly told his charioteer, "Bring this chariot near."
translations.hindi: यमपुरी में जाकर उन्होन देखा कि, यमराज आग्नि को साची कर, जीवों का यथोचित न्याय कर रहे हैं अथात्‌ जिसका जैसा अच्छा बुरा कमे है, तदसुसार उसको पुरस्कार एवं दरड दे रहे हैँ

verses.sloka: तस्य सूतस्तदा दिव्यमुपस्थाप्य महारथम् ।स्थितः स च महातेजा ह्यध्यारोहत तं रथम् ।प्राशमुद्गरहस्तश्च मृत्युस्तस्याग्रतः स्थितः ।। ७.२२.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya sūtastadā divyamupasthāpya mahāratham ।sthitaḥ sa ca mahātejā hyadhyārohata taṁ ratham ।prāśamudgarahastaśca mṛtyustasyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ ।। 7.22.3 ॥

translations.english: Then, his charioteer, having brought near the divine great chariot, stood ready, and Yama, of great splendor, indeed ascended that chariot, while Death, holding a spear and mace, stood before him.

verses.sloka: येन सङ्क्षिप्यते सर्वं त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम् ।कालदण्डस्तु पार्श्वस्थो मूर्तिमानस्य चाभवत् ।यमप्रहरणं दिव्यं तेजसा ज्वलदग्निमत् ।। ७.२२.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yena saṅkṣipyate sarvaṁ trailokyamidamavyayam ।kāladaṇḍastu pārśvastho mūrtimānasya cābhavat ।yamapraharaṇaṁ divyaṁ tejasā jvaladagnimat ।। 7.22.4 ॥

translations.english: The imperishable three worlds are brought to an end by him, and the staff of Time, Yama's divine, blazing, fiery weapon, appeared personified by his side.
translations.hindi: हे महर्षे ! कहिए कुशल तो है ? धर्मका्यी में किसी प्रकार की बाधा तो नहीं पडती । हे देवगन्वडेपूजत ! तुम्हार पधारने का कारण क्या है ९

verses.sloka: तस्य पार्श्वेषु निच्छिद्राः कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ।। ७.२२.५ ।।पावकस्पर्शसङ्काशः स्थितो मूर्तश्च मुद्गरः ।। ७.२२.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya pārśveṣu nicchidrāḥ kālapāśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।। 7.22.5 ।।pāvakasparśasaṅkāśaḥ sthito mūrtaśca mudgaraḥ ।। 7.22.6 ॥

translations.english: On his sides were placed the inescapable nooses of Time.
translations.hindi: कं ~ बे 029 यमराज के इन बचनों को सुन नारद जा बोले कि, में अपने आने का कारण बतलाता हूँ तुम उसे सुनो ओर फिर जो करना हो सो करो

verses.sloka: ततो लोकत्रयं क्षुब्धमकम्पन्त दिवौकसः ।कालं दृष्ट्वा तथा क्रुद्धं सर्वलोकभयावहम् ।। ७.२२.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato lokatrayaṁ kṣubdhamakampanta divaukasaḥ ।kālaṁ dṛṣṭvā tathā kruddhaṁ sarvalokabhayāvaham ।। 7.22.7 ॥

translations.english: An embodied mace, whose touch was like fire, also stood there.
translations.hindi: हवे पितृराज ! दुर्जेय दशग्रीव तुमको बलप्रयोग द्वारा अपने बश में करने के लिए आ रहा है.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रचोदयन्सूतस्तानश्वान्रुचिरप्रभान् ।प्रययौ भीमसन्नादो यत्र रक्षःपतिः स्थितः ।। ७.२२.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pracodayansūtastānaśvānruciraprabhān ।prayayau bhīmasannādo yatra rakṣaḥpatiḥ sthitaḥ ।। 7.22.8 ॥

translations.english: Then, having seen Time thus enraged and terrifying to all worlds, the three worlds were agitated and the gods trembled.
translations.hindi: उतत रैक हे प्रभो ! मैं इसी लिए अति शीघ्र तुम्हारे पास आया हुँ कि, देख्‌ कालदण्ड चलानेताले की जीत होती है कि हार

verses.sloka: मुहूर्तेन यमं ते तु हया हरिहयोपमाः ।प्रापयन्मनसस्तुल्या यत्र तत्प्रस्तुतं रणम् ।। ७.२२.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: muhūrtena yamaṁ te tu hayā harihayopamāḥ ।prāpayanmanasastulyā yatra tatprastutaṁ raṇam ।। 7.22.9 ॥

translations.english: Then, the charioteer, urging those brightly shining horses, proceeded with a terrible roar to where the lord of Rakshasas was situated.
translations.hindi: नारद जी यह कह ही रहे थे कि ) इसी बीच में सूय के समान चमचमाता दशग्रीच का पुष्पकविमान आता हुआ देख पड़ा

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा तथैव विकृतं रथं मृत्युसमन्वितम् ।सचिवा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सहसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ७.२२.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tathaiva vikṛtaṁ rathaṁ mṛtyusamanvitam ।sacivā rākṣasendrasya sahasā vipradudruvuḥ ।। 7.22.10 ॥

translations.english: In an instant, those horses, swift as thought and resembling Indra's steeds, brought Yama to the place where the battle had begun.

verses.sloka: लघुसत्त्वतया ते हि नष्टसञ्ज्ञा भयार्दिताः ।नेह योद्धुं समर्थाः स्म इत्युक्त्वा प्रययुर्दिशः ।। ७.२२.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: laghusattvatayā te hi naṣṭasañjñā bhayārditāḥ ।neha yoddhuṁ samarthāḥ sma ityuktvā prayayurdiśaḥ ।। 7.22.11 ॥

translations.english: Upon seeing that terrifying chariot, which seemed to embody death itself, the ministers of Ravana immediately fled in every direction.
translations.hindi: महाबली रावण ने देखा कि, वहाँ समस्त प्राणी अपने अपन पुण्यां ओर पापों का भला बुरा फल भोग रहे हैं

verses.sloka: स तु तं तादृशं दृष्ट्वा रथं लोकभयावहम् ।नाक्षुभ्यत दशग्रीवो न चापि भयमाविशत् ।। ७.२२.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu taṁ tādṛśaṁ dṛṣṭvā rathaṁ lokabhayāvaham ।nākṣubhyata daśagrīvo na cāpi bhayamāviśat ।। 7.22.12 ॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed by fear and having lost their senses due to their weak courage, they declared, "We are not capable of fighting here," and fled in all directions.

verses.sloka: स तु रावणमासाद्य व्यसृजच्छक्तितोमरान् ।यमो मर्माणि सङ्क्रुद्धो रावणस्योपकृन्तत ।। ७.२२.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu rāvaṇamāsādya vyasṛjacchaktitomarān ।yamo marmāṇi saṅkruddho rāvaṇasyopakṛntata ।। 7.22.13 ॥

translations.english: But Ravana, upon seeing that chariot which struck terror into the world, was neither disturbed nor did fear enter his heart.
translations.hindi: इससे जान पड़ता है, पुष्पक्रविमान में आज कल के सर्चलाइट लेंपों की तरह कितने ही लेंप लगे होंगे | उसने प्राणियों को बाँवते ओर मार पीट करते हुए.देखा । इससे प्राणी महापीड़ित हो बड़े जोर से रोइन कर चोत्कार कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: रावणस्तु ततः स्वस्थः शरवर्षं मुमोच ह ।तस्मिन्वैवस्वतरथे तोयवर्षमिवाम्बुदः ।। ७.२२.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇastu tataḥ svasthaḥ śaravarṣaṁ mumoca ha ।tasminvaivasvatarathe toyavarṣamivāmbudaḥ ।। 7.22.14 ॥

translations.english: Yama, greatly enraged, approached Ravana and hurled spears and javelins, piercing Ravana's vital spots.
translations.hindi: उन्हें विविध प्रकार के छोटे छोटे कीड़े और बड़े निष्ठुर कुरो काट रहे थे । वे ऐसी बुरी तरह चिल्ला रहे थे कि सुनने बाले का मन विकल हो जाता था

verses.sloka: ततो महाशक्तिशरैः पात्यमानैर्महोरसि (पात्यमानो) ।नाशक्नोत्प्रतिकर्तुं स राक्षसः शल्यपीडितः ।। ७.२२.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato mahāśaktiśaraiḥ pātyamānairmahorasi (pātyamāno) ।nāśaknotpratikartuṁ sa rākṣasaḥ śalyapīḍitaḥ ।। 7.22.15 ॥

translations.english: Ravana, having regained his composure, then released a shower of arrows upon Yama's chariot, much like a cloud pouring down rain.
translations.hindi: रावण ने बहुत से प्राणियों को देखा कि, वे जल की जगह रक्त से भरी अति गहरी वैतरणी नदी को पार कर रहे थे और तपे हुए बालू पर बार बार घसीटे जाते थे

verses.sloka: एवं नानाप्रहरणैर्यमेनामित्रकर्षिणा ।सप्तरात्रं कृतः सङ्ख्ये विसञ्ज्ञो विमुखो रिपुः ।। ७.२२.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ nānāpraharaṇairyamenāmitrakarṣiṇā ।saptarātraṁ kṛtaḥ saṅkhye visañjño vimukho ripuḥ ।। 7.22.16 ॥

translations.english: Then, as powerful arrows struck his broad chest, that demon, afflicted by the shafts, was unable to retaliate.

verses.sloka: तदासीत्तुमुलं युद्धं यमराक्षसयोर्द्वयोः ।जयमाकाङ्क्षतोर्वीर समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः ।। ७.२२.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadāsīttumulaṁ yuddhaṁ yamarākṣasayordvayoḥ ।jayamākāṅkṣatorvīra samareṣvanivartinoḥ ।। 7.22.17 ॥

translations.english: Thus, for seven nights in battle, the enemy Ravana was rendered senseless and turned away by Yama, the tormentor of foes, using various weapons.
translations.hindi: वे प्यासे और भूखे हो कर पानी माँग रहे थे। मुदै की तरह दुबले, दुखी, सिर के बाल खोले, मैल ओर कीचड़ से सने हुए, रुखे और दौड़ते हुए उन लोगों की रंगत ही बदली हुई थी । वहाँ पर रावण ने इस प्रकार के सेकड़ों सहस्र दुःखी जीव देखे

verses.sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य समेतास्तद्रणाजिरम् ।। ७.२२.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।prajāpatiṁ puraskṛtya sametāstadraṇājiram ।। 7.22.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, a fierce battle ensued between Yama and the demon, both unyielding warriors desiring victory in their fight.

verses.sloka: संवर्त इव लोकानां क्रुध्यतोरभवत्तदा ।राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य प्रेतानामीश्वरस्य च ।। ७.२२.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: saṁvarta iva lokānāṁ krudhyatorabhavattadā ।rākṣasānāṁ ca mukhyasya pretānāmīśvarasya ca ।। 7.22.19 ॥

translations.english: Then, the gods, along with Gandharvas, Siddhas, and great sages, assembled at that battlefield, led by Prajapati Brahma.
translations.hindi: रावण ने वहाँ ऐसे पुण्यात्माओं को भी देखा, जो अपने पुण्य वल से सुन्दर सुन्दर घरों में रहते थे और गानवाद्य से आनन्दित हो रहें थे

verses.sloka: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽपि विस्फार्य चापमिन्द्राशनिप्रभम् ।निरन्तरमिवाकाशं कुर्वन्बाणांस्ततो ऽसृजत् ।। ७.२२.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasendro 'pi visphārya cāpamindrāśaniprabham ।nirantaramivākāśaṁ kurvanbāṇāṁstato 'sṛjat ।। 7.22.20 ॥

translations.english: Then, the battle between the chief of the Rākṣasas and the lord of the departed spirits became like the cosmic dissolution of the worlds.

verses.sloka: मृत्युं चतुर्भिर्विशिखैः सूतं सप्तभिरार्दयत् ।यमं शतसहस्रेण शीघ्रं मर्मस्वताडयत् ।। ७.२२.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: mṛtyuṁ caturbhirviśikhaiḥ sūtaṁ saptabhirārdayat ।yamaṁ śatasahasreṇa śīghraṁ marmasvatāḍayat ।। 7.22.21 ॥

translations.english: The lord of Rākṣasas, drawing his bow which shone like Indra's thunderbolt, then released arrows, making the sky appear as if it had no gaps.
translations.hindi: बहुत से धर्मात्मा लोग सोना, मणि, मुक्ता और खियों को पा कर विहार कर रहे थे और अपने तेज से प्रकाशमान थे

verses.sloka: ततः क्रुद्धस्य वदनाद्यमस्य समजायत ।ज्वालामाली सनिःश्वासः सधूमः कोपपावकः ।। ७.२२.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddhasya vadanādyamasya samajāyata ।jvālāmālī saniḥśvāsaḥ sadhūmaḥ kopapāvakaḥ ।। 7.22.22 ॥

translations.english: Rāvaṇa wounded Death with four sharp arrows, afflicted the charioteer with seven, and quickly struck Yama in his vital spots with a hundred thousand arrows.
translations.hindi: एक £ ७ “ ' एकावश; सग; | १६३ वहाँ उस महाबली राक्षतराज रात्रण ने इस प्रकार के दृश्य देखे | तदनन्तर अपने पापकर्मा के फल से काटे पीठे जाते हुए प्राणियों को

verses.sloka: तदाश्चर्यमथो दृष्ट्वा देवदानवसन्निधौ ।प्रहर्षितौ सुसंरब्धौ मृत्युकालौ बभूवतुः ।। ७.२२.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadāścaryamatho dṛṣṭvā devadānavasannidhau ।praharṣitau susaṁrabdhau mṛtyukālau babhūvatuḥ ।। 7.22.23 ॥

translations.english: Then, from the enraged Yama's face, a fire of anger arose, garlanded with flames, accompanied by his breath and smoke.
translations.hindi: बलवान रावण ने जबदंस्ती छुड़ा दिया। राक्षसराज दशग्रीब द्वारा छुड़ाये हुए उन प्राणियों ने

verses.sloka: ततो मृत्युः क्रुद्धतरो वैवस्वतमभाषत ।मुञ्च मां समरे यावद्धन्मीमं पापराक्षसम् ।नैषा रक्षो भवेदद्य मर्यादा हि निसर्गतः ।। ७.२२.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato mṛtyuḥ kruddhataro vaivasvatamabhāṣata ।muñca māṁ samare yāvaddhanmīmaṁ pāparākṣasam ।naiṣā rakṣo bhavedadya maryādā hi nisargataḥ ।। 7.22.24 ॥

translations.english: Then, having witnessed that marvel in the presence of gods and Dānavas, Death and Kāla became greatly delighted and exceedingly furious.
translations.hindi: थोड़ी देर तक अतकित और अचिन्त्य सुख भोगा । महा- बली रावण द्वारा जीवों को छूटा हुआ देखा

verses.sloka: हिरण्यकशिपुः श्रीमान्नमुचिः शम्बरस्तथा ।विसन्धिर्धूमकेतुश्च बलिर्वैरोचनो ऽपि च ।। ७.२२.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipuḥ śrīmānnamuciḥ śambarastathā ।visandhirdhūmaketuśca balirvairocano 'pi ca ।। 7.22.25 ॥

translations.english: Then, Death, even more enraged, spoke to Yama, saying, "Release me in battle so that I may kill this sinful demon, for by nature, this demon should not exist today as a boundary."
translations.hindi: यमकिङ्करों ने क्रोध में भर, रावण १२ आक्रमण किआ । धर्मराज के किङ्कर बड़े शूरवीर थे । जब वे रावण के ऊपर दौड़े, तब चारों ओर हलहलाशब्द व्याप्त हो गया

verses.sloka: दम्भुर्दैत्यमहाराजो वृत्रो बाणस्तथैव च ।राजर्षयः शास्त्रविदो गन्धर्वाः समहोरगाः ।। ७.२२.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: dambhurdaityamahārājo vṛtro bāṇastathaiva ca ।rājarṣayaḥ śāstravido gandharvāḥ samahoragāḥ ।। 7.22.26 ॥

translations.english: The glorious Hiranyakashipu, Namuchi, Shambara, Visandhi, Dhumaketu, and Bali Vairochana were among them.

verses.sloka: ऋषयः पन्नगा दैत्या यक्षाश्चाप्यप्सरोगणाः ।युगान्तपरिवर्ते च पृथिवी समहार्णवा ।। ७.२२.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ pannagā daityā yakṣāścāpyapsarogaṇāḥ ।yugāntaparivarte ca pṛthivī samahārṇavā ।। 7.22.27 ॥

translations.english: Dambhu, the great king of Daityas, Vritra, and Bana, along with royal sages who knew the scriptures, Gandharvas, and great serpents, were also present.

verses.sloka: क्षयं नीता महाराज सपर्वतसरिद्द्रुमा ।एते चान्ये च बहवो बलवन्तो दुरासदाः ।। ७.२२.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣayaṁ nītā mahārāja saparvatasariddrumā ।ete cānye ca bahavo balavanto durāsadāḥ ।। 7.22.28 ॥

translations.english: Sages, serpents, Daityas, Yakshas, and groups of Apsaras, along with the earth and its great oceans at the end of an age, were all present.

verses.sloka: विनिपन्ना मया दृष्टाः किमुतायं निशाचरः ।। ७.२२.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: vinipannā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ kimutāyaṁ niśācaraḥ ।। 7.22.29 ॥

translations.english: O great king, these and many other powerful and formidable beings, along with mountains, rivers, and trees, were all brought to destruction.

verses.sloka: मुञ्चं मां साधु धर्मज्ञ यावदेनं निहन्म्यहम् ।नहि कश्चिन्मया दृष्टो बलवानपि जीवति ।। ७.२२.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: muñcaṁ māṁ sādhu dharmajña yāvadenaṁ nihanmyaham ।nahi kaścinmayā dṛṣṭo balavānapi jīvati ।। 7.22.30 ॥

translations.english: I have seen many fallen, so what to say of this demon?

verses.sloka: बलं मम न खल्वेतन्मर्यादैषा निसर्गतः ।स दृष्टो न मया कालं मुहुर्तमापि जीवति ।। ७.२२.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: balaṁ mama na khalvetanmaryādaiṣā nisargataḥ ।sa dṛṣṭo na mayā kālaṁ muhurtamāpi jīvati ।। 7.22.31 ॥

translations.english: O knower of dharma, release me so I may kill this one, for no one seen by me, however powerful, has ever lived.

verses.sloka: तस्यैवं वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मराजः प्रतापवान् ।अब्रवीत्तत्र तं मुत्युं त्वं तिष्ठैनं निहन्म्यहम् ।। ७.२२.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṁ vacanaṁ śrutvā dharmarājaḥ pratāpavān ।abravīttatra taṁ mutyuṁ tvaṁ tiṣṭhainaṁ nihanmyaham ।। 7.22.32 ॥

translations.english: This is not merely my strength, but a natural rule that anyone seen by me does not live even for a moment.

verses.sloka: ततः संरक्तनयनः क्रुद्धो वैवस्वतः प्रभुः ।कालदण्डममोघं तु तोलयामास पाणिना ।। ७.२२.३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṁraktanayanaḥ kruddho vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ ।kāladaṇḍamamoghaṁ tu tolayāmāsa pāṇinā ।। 7.22.33 ॥

translations.english: Having heard his words, the powerful Dharmaraja then said to Death, "You wait, I will kill this one."

verses.sloka: यस्य पार्श्वेषु निखिला कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ।पावकाशनिसङ्काशो मुद्गरो मूर्तिमान्स्थितः ।। ७.२२.३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yasya pārśveṣu nikhilā kālapāśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।pāvakāśanisaṅkāśo mudgaro mūrtimānsthitaḥ ।। 7.22.34 ॥

translations.english: Then, the enraged Lord Yama, with blood-red eyes, indeed lifted his unfailing rod of death with his hand.

verses.sloka: दर्शनादेव यः प्राणान्प्राणिनामपकर्षति ।किं पुनः स्पृश्यमानस्य पात्यमानस्य वा पुनः ।। ७.२२.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: darśanādeva yaḥ prāṇānprāṇināmapakarṣati ।kiṁ punaḥ spṛśyamānasya pātyamānasya vā punaḥ ।। 7.22.35 ॥

translations.english: On whose sides all the nooses of Death are established, and an embodied mace, resembling fire and lightning, stands.
translations.hindi: रावण भी शूल, गदा, प्रास, शक्ति, तोमर और बाणो' को चला रहा था। वह असो के बल यसकिङ्करो पर शिलाओ ओर वृक्षो की वृष्टि कर रहा था

verses.sloka: स ज्वालापरिवारस्तु निर्दहन्निव राक्षसम् ।तेन स्पृष्टो बलवता महाप्रहरणो ऽस्फुरत् ।। ७.२२.३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa jvālāparivārastu nirdahanniva rākṣasam ।tena spṛṣṭo balavatā mahāpraharaṇo 'sphurat ।। 7.22.36 ॥

translations.english: What more can be said of one who is touched or struck down, when merely by sight it draws away the lives of living beings?

verses.sloka: ततो विदुद्रुवुः सर्वे तस्मात्रस्ता रणाजिरे ।सुराश्च क्षुभिताः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा दण्डोद्यतं यमम् ।। ७.२२.३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato vidudruvuḥ sarve tasmātrastā raṇājire ।surāśca kṣubhitāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā daṇḍodyataṁ yamam ।। 7.22.37 ॥

translations.english: That great weapon, surrounded by flames as if burning the demon, trembled when touched by the powerful Yama.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन्प्रहर्तुकामे तु यमे दण्डेन रावणम् ।यमं पितामहः साक्षाद्दर्शयित्वेदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.२२.३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasminprahartukāme tu yame daṇḍena rāvaṇam ।yamaṁ pitāmahaḥ sākṣāddarśayitvedamabravīt ।। 7.22.38 ॥

translations.english: Then all those on the battlefield, terrified by that, fled, and all the gods were agitated upon seeing Yama with his mace raised.

verses.sloka: वैवस्वत महाबाहो न खल्वमितविक्रम ।न हन्तव्यस्त्वया तेन दण्डेनैव निशाचरः ।। ७.२२.३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: vaivasvata mahābāho na khalvamitavikrama ।na hantavyastvayā tena daṇḍenaiva niśācaraḥ ।। 7.22.39 ॥

translations.english: When Yama was indeed desirous of striking Ravana with his mace, the grandfather Brahma directly appeared before Yama and spoke these words.

verses.sloka: वरः खलु मयैतस्मै दत्तस्त्रिदशपुङ्गव ।स त्वया नानृतः कार्यो यन्मया व्याहृतं वचः ।। ७.२२.४० ॥
verses.transliteration: varaḥ khalu mayaitasmai dattastridaśapuṅgava ।sa tvayā nānṛtaḥ kāryo yanmayā vyāhṛtaṁ vacaḥ ।। 7.22.40 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed Yama, son of Vivasvat, you of immeasurable prowess, indeed that demon should not be killed by your staff alone.

verses.sloka: यो हि मामनृतं कुर्याद्देवो वा मानुषो ऽपि वा ।त्रैलोक्यमनृतं तेन कृतं स्यान्नात्र संशयः ।। ७.२२.४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: yo hi māmanṛtaṁ kuryāddevo vā mānuṣo 'pi vā ।trailokyamanṛtaṁ tena kṛtaṁ syānnātra saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.22.41 ॥

translations.english: O chief among gods, indeed a boon has been given by me to him, and that word spoken by me should not be made false by you.
translations.hindi: कुछ ही देर में रावण सम्हल गया । फिर कुपित हो बह हाथ में धनुष बाण ले दूसरे यमराज की तरह लड़ने के लिए . तेयार हुआ |, ३६ ॥ ततः पाशुपतं दिव्यमश्ध' सन्थायझामके । तिए तिष्ठेति तानुकस्या तच्चापं &व्यपकर्षत

verses.sloka: क्रुद्धेन विप्रमुक्तो ऽयं निर्विशेषं प्रियाप्रिये ।प्रजाः संहरते रौद्रो लोकत्रयभयावहः ।। ७.२२.४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: kruddhena vipramukto 'yaṁ nirviśeṣaṁ priyāpriye ।prajāḥ saṁharate raudro lokatrayabhayāvahaḥ ।। 7.22.42 ॥

translations.english: Whoever, be it a god or even a human, would make my word false, by him the three worlds would indeed be made false, there is no doubt about this.

verses.sloka: अमोघो ह्येष सर्वेषां प्राणिनाममितप्रभः ।कालदण्डो मया सृष्टः पूर्वं मृत्युपुरस्कृतः ।। ७.२२.४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: amogho hyeṣa sarveṣāṁ prāṇināmamitaprabhaḥ ।kāladaṇḍo mayā sṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaṁ mṛtyupuraskṛtaḥ ।। 7.22.43 ॥

translations.english: This terrible staff, when released by an angry one, destroys creatures without distinction between dear and not dear, causing fear to all three worlds.
translations.hindi: धुआँ और ज्वालामण्डल से युक्त उस अस्ध का रूप ग्रीष्म- काल में वनदहनकारी धधकते हुए दावाग्नि की तरह दिखाई देने लगा

verses.sloka: तन्न खल्वेष ते सौम्य पात्यो रावणमूर्धनि ।नह्यस्मिन्पतिते कश्चिन्मुहूर्तमपि जीवति ।। ७.२२.४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tanna khalveṣa te saumya pātyo rāvaṇamūrdhani ।nahyasminpatite kaścinmuhūrtamapi jīvati ।। 7.22.44 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, this unfailing staff of Time, of immeasurable power for all living beings, was created by me long ago, with Death as its foremost aspect.

verses.sloka: यदि ह्यन्मिन्निपतिते न म्रियेतैष राक्षसः ।म्रियते वा दशग्रीवस्तदाप्युभयतो ऽनृतम् ।। ७.२२.४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi hyanminnipatite na mriyetaiṣa rākṣasaḥ ।mriyate vā daśagrīvastadāpyubhayato 'nṛtam ।। 7.22.45 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one (Yama), this rod of yours should certainly not be cast upon Ravana's head, for indeed, no one survives even for a moment once this rod has fallen.
translations.hindi: उस अल्ल के तेज से यमराज के समस्त वीर सेनिक भस्म हो कर, इन्द्र की ध्वजा की तरह गिर पड़े

verses.sloka: तन्निवर्तय लङ्केशं द्दण्डमेतं समुद्यतम् ।सत्यं च मां कुरुष्वाद्य लोकांस्त्वं यद्यवेक्षसे ।। ७.२२.४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tannivartaya laṅkeśaṁ ddaṇḍametaṁ samudyatam ।satyaṁ ca māṁ kuruṣvādya lokāṁstvaṁ yadyavekṣase ।। 7.22.46 ॥

translations.english: If this demon (Ravana) does not die even after this rod has fallen, or if Ravana dies, then in either case, it would be a falsehood (regarding the boon of immortality).

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच यमस्तदा ।एष व्यावर्तितो दण्डः प्रभविष्णुर्हि नो भवान् ।। ७.२२.४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā pratyuvāca yamastadā ।eṣa vyāvartito daṇḍaḥ prabhaviṣṇurhi no bhavān ।। 7.22.47 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, withdraw this uplifted rod from Ravana and make my words true now, if you indeed care for the worlds.

verses.sloka: किं न्विदानीं मया शक्यं कर्तुं रणगतेन हि ।न मया यद्ययं शक्यो हन्तुं वरपुरस्कृतः ।। ७.२२.४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁ nvidānīṁ mayā śakyaṁ kartuṁ raṇagatena hi ।na mayā yadyayaṁ śakyo hantuṁ varapuraskṛtaḥ ।। 7.22.48 ॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to, the righteous Yama then replied, "This rod has been withdrawn, for indeed, you are our powerful lord."

verses.sloka: एष तस्मात्प्रणश्यामि दर्शनादस्य रक्षसः ।इत्युक्त्वा सरथः साश्वस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।। ७.२२.४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa tasmātpraṇaśyāmi darśanādasya rakṣasaḥ ।ityuktvā sarathaḥ sāśvastatraivāntaradhīyata ।। 7.22.49 ॥

translations.english: What indeed can I do now, having come to battle, if this one (Ravana) cannot be killed by me because he is protected by a boon?

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवस्तु तं जित्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः ।आरुह्य पुष्पकं भूयो निष्क्रान्तो यमसादनात् ।। ७.२२.५० ॥
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvastu taṁ jitvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ ।āruhya puṣpakaṁ bhūyo niṣkrānto yamasādanāt ।। 7.22.50 ॥

translations.english: Having said, "Therefore, I disappear from the sight of this demon," he vanished right there with his chariot and horses.

verses.sloka: स तु वैवस्वतो देवैः सह ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः ।जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो नारदश्च महामुनिः ।। ७.२२.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu vaivasvato devaiḥ saha brahmapurogamaiḥ ।jagāma tridivaṁ hṛṣṭo nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ ।। 7.22.51 ।।

translations.english: Dashagriva, having conquered him and proclaimed his own name, ascended the Pushpaka chariot again and departed from Yama's abode.
